item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hello there! Let's get started. Happy weekend! A whole day to play. Here's your weather for Saturday, November 14. Saturday! No school and no hurry today. Looking outside in Shanghai, today will be on and off showers. The high will be 20 degrees, and the low will be 16 degrees. Nice and comfortable today, not too hot and not too cold. The chance of rain is 100 percent. Did you know today is day 318 of the year? There are 47 days to go until the new one. Don't forget your umbrella today! As for tomorrow, expect it to be covered in clouds, with a high of 20 degrees. Think about this one: what is the funniest sound you can make? And that's it for today's weather. Have a lovely time!
